company.name: Embrace Doha
company.shortDescription: Embrace Doha is a cultural organization that promotes traditional programs, hospitality, ethnic clothing, local goods, and heritage tourism.
company.description: Embrace Doha provides a diverse range of events and cultural services aimed at enriching the cultural experiences of expatriates and visitors. Its offerings include Qatari cultural sessions, discussions on Qatar’s traditions, history, and geography, as well as educational programs and business protocol sessions designed to support effective engagement with oil and gas companies, banks, and other organizations. Through curated activities, excursions, and entertainment, Embrace Doha enables companies, ministries, educational institutions, and the wider public to enhance cultural knowledge and awareness among their employees and guests.
